item.title: ImAnim: Modern animation capabilities to ImGui applications
item.description:
📝 ImAnim Animation Engine for Dear ImGui ImAnim brings modern animation capabilities to ImGui applications. Documentation Full documentation in the docs/ folder: Quick Start - Get running in 5 minutes Tweens - Immediate-mode animation Clips - Timeline-based keyframe animation Easing - All 30+ easing functions Motion Paths - Animate along curves Text Along Paths - Curved text rendering Stagger - Cascading element animations Oscillators - Continuous periodic motion Shake & Wiggle - Feedback and organic motion Noise - Perlin/Simplex procedural animation Text Stagger - Per-character text effects Style Interpolation - Animated theme transitions Anchors - Resize-aware animation Debug - Inspector and debugging tools Demo The demo/ folder contains a comprehensive demo showcasing all features: Interactive easing curve visualizer Cubic bezier editor Spring physics playground All animation types with live controls Performance benchmarks Showcase List Stagger Grid Stagger Card Animation Color Blending Wave Color Gradient ImGui Integration Contributing Development is supported through Patreon: License MIT License - see LICENSE for details. Made for the Dear ImGui community.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/soufianekhiat/ImAnim

item.title: Better Auth (YC X25) Is Hiring
item.description:
